authority: PI, 2026-09-02: 'Did the intended mechanism survive training? before asking Did it produce strategic crossover?' Four rules: terminal checkpoint only, run exactly the preregistered diagnostic, descriptive not a gate, freeze before opening EVAL.
PURPOSE: Characterise what the terminal policy actually became, independent of and before any payoff reading. Reuses V3/V4's Layer 1-3 machinery as literally as possible for continuity with the whole ladder (V1 -> OG-PSP -> V3 -> V4 -> this), then adds ONE prospective interpretive note specific to this successor's genuinely different training objective -- not a new metric, not a new threshold, an interpretation rule frozen before the numbers exist.

RULE_1_TERMINAL_CHECKPOINT_ONLY.rule: no periodic checkpoint comparison. The sha is a literal constant in the diagnostic script and cross-checked against CCP_SUCCESSOR_MODEL_FROZEN.json; both must agree with the bytes on disk or the diagnostic refuses to run.

RULE_2_LITERAL_MACHINERY_REUSE.layer_1_source: experiments/diagnose_hog_psp_v4_mechanism.py, imported as a live code object (V3D chain: V4 imported V3's bootstrap function and constants directly; this diagnostic imports V4's module the same way) -- the state-level ruler, CALIB block, bootstrap procedure, and reference values are NOT redefined.
RULE_2_LITERAL_MACHINERY_REUSE.layer_2_source: same file: pole-specific frozen discriminators D_A/D_B, sign convention re-asserted at runtime, full-cross forced-latent rollouts, RAW decision_function score, paired percentile bootstrap n_boot=20000 alpha=0.05 rng=7.
RULE_2_LITERAL_MACHINERY_REUSE.no_new_metric: nothing is measured here that OG-PSP's diagnostic did not already measure.
RULE_2_LITERAL_MACHINERY_REUSE.CALIB_disjoint_from_training_either_way: CALIB 10700097..10700128 was never trained on by V1/OG-PSP/V3/V4, and is equally disjoint from THIS successor's training: fresh_step_0 environment seeds and the 7 non-zero causal segments all come from the 115xxxxx/116xxxxx namespaces. CALIB remains a genuine held-out generalisation probe for this successor exactly as it was for the whole ladder.

RULE_3_DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_A_GATE.a_weak_or_surprising_result_does_not_pre: per the PI's rule 3, stated verbatim. EVAL 11600101..11600132 opening is a SEPARATE explicit decision regardless of what this diagnostic reads.
RULE_3_DESCRIPTIVE_NOT_A_GATE.runs_before_EVAL: so the mechanism reading cannot be shaped by the payoff outcome

RULE_4_FREEZE_BEFORE_EVAL: this diagnostic must be run and frozen in full before any decision to open EVAL 11600101..11600132 is made or discussed with outcome numbers on the table.

NEW_PREREGISTERED_INTERPRETIVE_NOTE_NOT_.why_this_note_is_necessary: V1 through V4 all trained z0 toward a UNIFORM A-identity and z1 toward a UNIFORM B-identity, across the whole paired bank or the whole trajectory-identity objective. THIS successor's objective is qualitatively different: winner-directed SEQUENCE supervision taught each latent whichever specialist was CAUSALLY BETTER at each of 7 specific measured boundaries -- and at one of those boundaries (11500105|A|83), the measured effect was NEGATIVE, meaning z0 was deliberately taught toward pi_B there, not pi_A. Layer 2's D_A/D_B trajectory-identity score presumes a clean A-identity-for-z0 / B-identity-for-z1 hypothesis. A CALIB-level result that looks weaker or more mixed than V3/V4's under that same ruler is NOT automatically evidence the mechanism failed to preserve what it was actually taught -- it could equally mean the mechanism correctly localised behaviour to the 7 measured segments rather than generalising a global identity, which the training objective never asked it to do.
NEW_PREREGISTERED_INTERPRETIVE_NOTE_NOT_.what_this_note_does_NOT_permit: it does not relax, adjust, or reinterpret the frozen PREREGISTERED_READINGS below after seeing the numbers. The categorical reading (CONFIRMED / PARTIAL / NOT_CONFIRMED) is computed exactly as V3/V4's was, on the same rule, with no exception carved out for this successor. This note governs the PROSE INTERPRETATION accompanying the categorical result, not the category itself.
NEW_PREREGISTERED_INTERPRETIVE_NOTE_NOT_.concretely: if the reading comes back PARTIAL or NOT_CONFIRMED, the record must state BOTH readings side by side: (a) the categorical result under the unchanged V1-V4 ruler, unmodified, and (b) whether the observed pattern is consistent with 'localised causal correction' rather than 'failed to learn anything' -- for example, by checking (descriptively, not as a new gate) whether z0/z1 trajectory scores at CALIB move in a direction consistent with the SIGN of the nearest causal segment's teacher, where such a comparison is possible. This is descriptive commentary alongside the frozen categorical reading, never a substitute for it.

PREREGISTERED_READINGS.note: identical categories and identical decision rule to V3/V4's, unmodified
PREREGISTERED_READINGS.TRAJECTORY_IDENTITY_CONFIRMED: Correct ordering on BOTH poles with paired-bootstrap LCB95 > 0 on both.
PREREGISTERED_READINGS.TRAJECTORY_IDENTITY_PARTIAL: Correct, confident separation on only one pole; or correct point ordering on both without confidence on both.
PREREGISTERED_READINGS.TRAJECTORY_IDENTITY_NOT_CONFIRMED: Trajectory gaps near zero, reversed, or otherwise failing to establish latent-specific teacher identity.

THE_INFORMATIVE_COMBINATIONS_WITH_A_FUTU.note: recorded now, before either the diagnostic or EVAL exist, per the PI's own framing
THE_INFORMATIVE_COMBINATIONS_WITH_A_FUTU.strong_mechanism_and_EVAL_crosses_over: causal supervision -> preserved latent mechanism -> complementary payoff. The strongest possible result for the program.
THE_INFORMATIVE_COMBINATIONS_WITH_A_FUTU.strong_mechanism_and_EVAL_does_not_cross: causal supervision worked mechanistically but still did not yield reliable crossover. A materially different finding from V3's (identity confirmed via UNIFORM pressure, payoff reversed) because this mechanism was built from measured causal effect, not teacher disagreement.
THE_INFORMATIVE_COMBINATIONS_WITH_A_FUTU.weak_mechanism: the successor failed before the payoff layer could even be tested cleanly. Under RULE_3 this does not block EVAL, but it changes how any EVAL result -- pass or fail -- should be weighted in the paper.

WHAT_THIS_DIAGNOSTIC_MAY_NOT_DO: alter lambda, the discriminators, the feature map, or any treatment parameter
use intermediate training episodes or training-time discriminator scores
be re-run with different seeds or a different statistic after its numbers are seen
redefine the Layer 1 or Layer 2 measurements, which exist to preserve comparability with V1, OG-PSP, V3 and V4
use the new interpretive note to change the categorical reading itself

PROVENANCE.the_qualitative_objective_difference_thi: rl/causal_supervision.py (winner-directed routing, commit 6cff3568), CCP_PHASE1_CAUSAL_BRANCHING.json (the one negative-routed segment example, 11500105|A|83)
